query: Tracking says my rug was delivered on the 12th, but I didn't spot it on the porch until the 15th. The promised date was the 10th, so that's five days late, right?
note: 2024.1: arrival is the delivered event (12th), only 2 days after the promised 10th, under the 3-day threshold, so on time

query: The package was a whole week late. Do I get my shipping money back or something else?
note: 2024.1 remedy is a flat store credit, not a shipping refund

query: Ordered on Dec 27 and tracking has been frozen for two weeks. Your site says it's lost after 14 days, so can you call it lost now?
note: late-Dec 2024 order keeps the 2024.1 21-day lost rule; customer quotes the newer 14

query: My parcel is officially lost and the agent wants to just reship it, but I'd rather have my money back. Do I get to pick?
note: lost remedy is the customer's choice

query: A blizzard held up my delivery right before New Year's. Does that mean I don't get anything for it being late?
note: weather does not remove the late remedy; order date governs (2024.1)

query: I typed my house number wrong and the box bounced around for weeks before reaching me. Can I still get the late-delivery credit?
note: customer address error excludes late/lost remedies

query: I placed my order on Dec 30 and it came late, but I'm only filing the claim now in January. Do I get this year's shipping rules or the ones from when I ordered?
note: version question; §3.1 says claims follow the version in effect on the order date, so 2024-12-30 keeps 2024.1

query: Checkout told me it would arrive on the 9th, but the chat rep later said the 12th. Which one counts if it shows up late?
note: early-Jan 2025 order; a date given in chat does not replace the promised date

query: I read that a package has to be 3 days late before you do anything. Mine came 2 days after the promised date, so am I out of luck?
note: quotes the outdated 3-day threshold; 2025.1 counts 2 days as late

query: My order arrived late. Is it still the $5 store credit, or do you do something different now?
note: quotes the 2024.1 $5 credit; 2025.1 refunds the shipping fee instead

query: Someone told me I have to wait 21 days with no tracking update before you'll treat my parcel as lost. It's been 15 days. Do I really have to keep waiting?
note: quotes the outdated 21 days; 2025.1 declares lost after 14

query: My package never arrived and you've confirmed it's lost. Send me a replacement, and since this has been such a hassle I want the item price refunded too.
note: one remedy per lost item: replacement or refund, never both

query: There was a carrier strike over the holidays and my order is stuck. Can you at least tell me what day it will get here?
note: late-Dec 2025 order stays on 2025.1; no promised dates beyond tracking, strike still qualifies

query: The driver left my parcel at the wrong house even though the address on my order is right. Are you saying that's my fault and I get nothing?
note: carrier mistake is not a customer address error

query: I deleted my confirmation email, but I'm sure checkout said it would be here by the 2nd. Can you just go by the date I remember?
note: 2026.1: promised date is read from the order record, not the customer's memory

query: I ordered on Jan 3 and it came 2 days after the promised date. Last year 2 days counted as late, does it still?
note: early-Jan 2026 order; quotes the 2025.1 2-day rule; 2026.1 needs 3 days

query: My order was late and I'd like the shipping fee refunded like last time. If not that, what do I get on a $300 order?
note: expects the 2025.1 shipping refund; 2026.1 gives store credit of 10% of the order total, $300 x 10% = $30, capped at $20

query: Tracking's been stuck for 11 days. Last year an agent told me a parcel only counts as lost after two weeks, so do I just keep waiting?
note: quotes the 2025.1 14-day rule; 2026.1 declares lost after 10 days without an update, so 11 days already qualifies

query: You confirmed my parcel is lost and I picked the refund over a replacement. Will the money go back on my card, or do I get store credit?
note: 2026.1: refund goes to the original payment method; the choice is noted in the ticket

query: Storms delayed my package, and I might have typed my apartment number wrong too. Do I still qualify for anything?
note: weather still qualifies, but a customer address error blocks the remedy
